name: items
description: The entries, newest first. Each takes `title`, `date`, and optionally `datetime`, `byline`, `text` or `html`.

params.name: date
params.description: Date as displayed, for example `12 March 2026`.

params.name: datetime
params.description: Machine-readable date for the `<time>` element, for example `2026-03-12`. Omitting it renders plain text instead.

params.name: html
params.description: Description as HTML, for lists or multiple paragraphs.

name: headingLevel
description: Heading level for each entry, 2 to 6. Defaults to 3. Set it so the timeline does not skip a level in the page's heading order.

name: classes
description: Classes to add to the timeline.

name: attributes
description: HTML attributes to add to the timeline.
